title: Who Jesus is
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. New wording, same facts: each claim is in the old film's captions or its 'differ' note, whose sources are in docs/work/elite/explorer-ledger.md. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, checked against client/public/bible/text/ by film/tools/write-script.py.

lines: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The Son did not begin at Bethlehem. Through him all things were made.

scripture.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

lines: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.
He didn't stop being God when he became man, and he didn't only seem to be a man. He took a real human nature. He was born, he grew, he learned.

scripture.text: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.

lines: The Gospels don't hide his humanity. Weary from walking, he sits down by a well. At his friend's tomb, Jesus wept.
Hebrews says he was tempted in every way that we are, yet without sin.

scripture.text: we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

lines: In Mark he tells a paralyzed man that his sins are forgiven, and the scribes object: who can forgive sins but God alone?
He rebukes the wind and the sea, and his friends ask the question.
Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?

scripture.text: Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?

lines: Not half God and half man. Not a man who became God. Not God dressed up as a man.
The church confessed it at the Council of Chalcedon in the year four fifty-one: one person who is truly God and truly man. Fully God and fully man, in one person, forever.

scripture.text: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.

lines: Only someone who is both could bring God and people back together.
As man he could stand in our place. As God he could carry what no one else could.

scripture.text: He had to be made like His brothers in every way

lines: Near Caesarea Philippi, after hearing what others said, Jesus asked: who do you say I am? Peter answered.
You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Some say he was only a good teacher. The Honest Answer on that question weighs it.

scripture.text: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

lines: One person, truly God and truly man.
